gloss: magic trick; conjuring; sleight of hand

definitions.gloss: magic trick; conjuring; sleight of hand; stage magic
definitions.explanation: The art or performance of stage magic — making objects appear, disappear, or transform in ways that seem impossible. A somewhat formal or old-fashioned word compared to the common loanword マジック.

examples.japanese: {奇術|きじゅつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せる→見せる：01988_miseru⟧。
⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{得意|とくい}→得意：03455_tokui⟧な{奇術|きじゅつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧たち⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{喜|よろこ}ばせた→喜ぶ：01169_yorokobu⟧。
examples.english: My grandfather delighted the children with his specialty magic trick.

examples.japanese: {奇術|きじゅつ}{師|し}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{観客|かんきゃく}→観客：02556_kankyaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{目|め}の{前|まえ}→目の前：22588_menomae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦コイン→コイン：10852_koin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{消|け}して→消す：00528_kesu⟧みせた。
examples.english: The magician made a coin vanish right before the audience's eyes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{伝統|でんとう}{的|てき}→伝統的：04802_dentouteki⟧な⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{奇術|きじゅつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{和傘|わがさ}→和傘：15380_wagasa⟧や⟦{扇子|せんす}→扇子：04039_sensu⟧⟦など→〜など：03095_nado⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{道具|どうぐ}→道具：01479_dougu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{巧|たく}み→巧み：07153_takumi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: Traditional Japanese magic skillfully uses tools such as paper umbrellas and folding fans.

notes:
Composed of {奇|き} (strange, marvelous, curious) and ⟦{術|じゅつ}→術：14265_jutsu⟧ (art, technique, skill). Refers to the art of performing illusions — card tricks, coin tricks, vanishing acts, and stage magic more broadly.

REGISTER: Somewhat formal or old-fashioned. In everyday conversation, the loanword ⟦マジック→マジック：11392_majikku⟧ or ⟦{手品|てじな}→手品：03443_tejina⟧ is far more common. {奇術|きじゅつ} is still used in literary contexts, for traditional Japanese stage magic, and in the word {奇術|きじゅつ}{師|し} (professional magician).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {奇術|きじゅつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to perform a magic trick (formal)
- {奇術|きじゅつ}{師|し}: a magician, conjurer
- {奇術|きじゅつ}⟦ショー→ショー：10950_shoo⟧: a magic show
- {奇術|きじゅつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{腕|うで}→腕：01006_ude⟧: skill at magic

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{手品|てじな}→手品：03443_tejina⟧: magic trick, sleight of hand — the everyday native word; most common in casual speech
- ⟦マジック→マジック：11392_majikku⟧: magic — the common English loanword; used for card magic, stage shows, and modern entertainment
- ⟦{魔術|まじゅつ}→魔術：17994_majutsu⟧: magic, sorcery — refers to supposed real magic or witchcraft, not stage tricks
- ⟦{幻術|げんじゅつ}→幻術：24983_genjutsu⟧: illusion, sorcery — more literary; used for supernatural illusions in fiction
